canonical_project: VOLT UAE / DIEZ AI-ready data center at Dubai Silicon Oasis
owner: VOLT UAE; Dubai Integrated Economic Zones Authority; Schneider Electric support
notes: Official Dubai Media Office announcement says DIEZ and VOLT UAE formed a JV to develop AI-ready data centres in Dubai Silicon Oasis; trade press reports 29MW first phase and potential expansion to 129MW. Dubai Silicon Oasis is in central/eastern Dubai, treated here as Sector 6 coverage.
